# Git Reader
> Read-only Git client for PHP. Resolve refs and read files from any Git host over HTTPS.

## Docs

- https://mrpunyapal.github.io/git-reader/: Git Reader
- https://mrpunyapal.github.io/git-reader/how-it-works: How it works
- https://mrpunyapal.github.io/git-reader/installation: Installation
- https://mrpunyapal.github.io/git-reader/limits: Limits
- https://mrpunyapal.github.io/git-reader/usage: Usage
